subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Now that current main has custom session groups, whole-transcript forks, batch session triage, and split panes, should this issue become the canonical tracker for selected-message branch-copy and multi-session composer delivery, or should those capabilities be split into separate trackers?
rationale: Transcript mutation/copy rules and multi-target delivery semantics affect durable session state and message routing; source inspection cannot determine the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Narrow this issue
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker for immutable selected-message branch-copy and explicit multi-session delivery, linking project/workspace policy to the separate Projects issue.

options.title: Split the remainder
options.body: Create separate canonical trackers for transcript branch-copy and multi-session delivery, then close this broad umbrella after preserving its context.

options.title: Accept current capabilities
options.body: Treat custom groups, forks, and split panes as sufficient and decline message-level triage and composer fanout.

recommendation.title: Narrow this issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker for immutable selected-message branch-copy and explicit multi-session delivery, linking project/workspace policy to the separate Projects issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged session-management implementation and prior issue review make this the strongest available routing signal for the product choice.
